reason: The plugin is primarily an automation utility for managing a local proxy service through the DSH web settings interface: it starts/stops the service, optionally auto-starts with DSH, refreshes model data, and performs connectivity checks via proxy endpoints. Evidence in README and package metadata indicates it is a DSH web plugin with explicit service lifecycle, model management, and local configuration behavior.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH Web 插件，用于在设置页里管理本地 opencode-free-proxy 服务，包括启动与停止、随 dsh 启动、模型刷新和连通性检查。
summaries.en: This is a DSH Web plugin for managing a local opencode-free-proxy service from the settings page, including start/stop control, optional auto-start with DSH, model refresh, and connectivity checks.

capabilities: Start and stop a local proxy service from plugin settings
Auto-start the proxy when DSH starts (if enabled)
Trigger proxy management endpoints for model refresh and health checks
Display proxy model list and basic connectivity metrics (latency/model count)
Persist and apply local service settings such as port and proxy directory

reasons.code: README: settings switch controls proxy start/stop, with dsh auto-start behavior when enabled.
README: functionality includes manual refresh through /admin/refresh-models and connectivity tests via /health and /v1/models.
README: runtime options include proxyDir and port persisted under ~/.dsh/settings.yaml and service restarts on in-run configuration changes.
package.json: declares DSH web client plugin metadata and dependency injection for UI settings/locale modules, confirming UI-facing plugin role.
